old_value: {"id":"project-LICHEN-worker6-t8ox","title":"Announce store capacity policy: cache-counted gate allows durable overflow and bricks pinned peers","description":"announce_store.rs capacity checks count self.records (volatile cache, resets on restart), not durable records. Trace: accept 40 originators, restart, accept 40 new ones (gate passes on empty cache) -\u003e 80 durable records; after next restart the first 64 load()s fill the cache and the remaining durably-pinned peers get Err(Full) from load()/accept() for the process lifetime. Separately an attacker can saturate the store with 64 self-minted TOFU identities, blocking new legitimate pins until restart, then re-fill after each restart. Fix: load() must return valid durable state even at full cache (skip the cache insert — cache is an optimization); accept's cap applies only to IIDs with no durable record; LRU-evict cache entries on capacity (durable floors persist). Test store_capacity_is_bounded only covers the ephemeral store.
